arguments.query:
WITH rows AS (
  SELECT 'net' AS kind, time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, filemod_name, object, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, access, source_stream, event_record_id, source_row_id, process_guid, raw_event_type
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE pid = 3076
    AND time BETWEEN '2022-07-16 15:00:46' AND '2022-07-16 15:03:35'
    AND raw_event_type = 'endpoint.event.netconn'
    AND netconn_domain IN ('discord.com','dl.discordapp.net','dyna.wikimedia.org','upload.wikimedia.org','en.wikipedia.org')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'file' AS kind, time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, filemod_name, object, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, access, source_stream, event_record_id, source_row_id, process_guid, raw_event_type
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE pid = 3076
    AND time BETWEEN '2022-07-16 15:00:46' AND '2022-07-16 15:03:35'
    AND (
      lower(coalesce(filemod_name,'')) IN ('c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe','c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe.part','c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe:zone.identifier')
      OR lower(coalesce(object,'')) IN ('c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe','c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe.part','c:\users\aalsahee\downloads\discordsetup.exe:zone.identifier')
    )
    AND (source_stream LIKE 'cbc%' OR access IN ('write','file_access','handle_request'))
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY kind, time, coalesce(filemod_name,''), coalesce(netconn_domain,''), coalesce(remote_ip,''), coalesce(remote_port,''), access, source_stream
    ORDER BY coalesce(event_record_id, source_row_id)
  ) AS rn
  FROM rows
)
SELECT kind, time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, filemod_name, object, netconn_domain, remote_ip, remote_port, access, source_stream, event_record_id, source_row_id, process_guid, raw_event_type
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY time, CASE kind WHEN 'net' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, event_record_id, source_row_id
LIMIT 30;
